counter_citations.point: Never return a nil error when an error check has caught a non-nil failure condition; callers rely on error semantics to determine success.
Go error-handling idiom requires that if a function returns an error, callers can trust that nil indicates complete success.

counter_citations.point: The %w verb formats an error and provides an Unwrap method returning it. Using %v or %s severs the error chain and breaks errors.Is / errors.As.
Always use %w when adding context to an error that callers may want to programmatically inspect.
